title: Add current mode to new_session.sh for respawn-pane behavior
description: new_session.sh needs a MODE=current that uses tmux respawn-pane -k instead of split-window or new-window. This enables the new A binding (attach current pane with new session).

title: Update tmux-agents.tmux: change default trigger g→a, remap all bindings
description: Change default trigger from g to a. Remap: p→attach_session pane, P→prompt_new_session pane, w→attach_session window, W→prompt_new_session window, a→switch_session, A→prompt_new_session current. Keep d/D/Esc.

title: Update README.md: keybindings table, all prefix+g references, config default
description: Update keybindings table to reflect new p/P/w/W/a/A scheme. Change all prefix+g references to prefix+a. Update config section default from g to a.
